en.hubeali: H 14579 – And by this chain, who has narrated the following: Imamasws said that: ‘The Prophetsaww said: ‘
Be merciful towards a mighty one who has been humbled, and a rich one who has become poor, and a scholar who is wasted in the era of the ignorant ones.
en.sarwar: 131. And by this chain, who has narrated the following: Imam (a.s.) said that: ‘The Prophet (saww) said: ‘
Be merciful towards a mighty one who has been humbled, and a rich one who has become poor, and a scholar who is wasted in the era of the ignorant ones.
